# watchpoint_agent_enrollment_token (Resource)

A bounded-use token that enrolls a Watchpoint agent (private location, infrastructure agent or Kubernetes operator). The plaintext token is returned only at creation, so it is written to Terraform state and must be treated as a secret. Every argument is fixed at creation and replaces the token when changed. Destroying the resource revokes the token. A token that has been used up or has expired is kept in state as created rather than recreated, so dependent resources are not replaced after a successful install; use `terraform apply -replace` to mint a new one. The provider credential needs the `profiles.manage` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A single-use token that enrolls one host as an infrastructure agent.
resource "watchpoint_agent_enrollment_token" "host" {
  roles = ["infrastructure-agent"]
}

# A token that lets up to three agents create (or join) a private location
# named "dc-east", valid for 48 hours, with auto-update disabled.
resource "watchpoint_agent_enrollment_token" "dc_east" {
  roles            = ["private-location", "infrastructure-agent"]
  location_name    = "dc-east"
  max_uses         = 3
  expires_in_hours = 48
  auto_update      = false
}

# The token and the install commands that embed it exist only in state and in
# these outputs. Mark any output that carries them as sensitive.
output "dc_east_enrollment_token" {
  value     = watchpoint_agent_enrollment_token.dc_east.token
  sensitive = true
}

output "dc_east_linux_install" {
  value     = watchpoint_agent_enrollment_token.dc_east.install_commands["linux"]
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `roles` (Set of String) Roles the enrolling agent may claim: `private-location`, `infrastructure-agent` and/or `kubernetes`.

### Optional

- `auto_update` (Boolean) Whether agents installed with the returned `install_commands` update themselves. Only affects the generated commands, not the token. Defaults to `true`.
- `expires_in_hours` (Number) Lifetime in hours from creation, from 1 to 720. Omit for the platform default of 7 days. The resulting timestamp is exported as `expires_at`.
- `location_id` (String) Existing private location to join. A `private-location` role needs either this or `location_name`.
- `location_name` (String) Name of the private location to create (or join, if one with this name already exists) when the agent enrolls.
- `max_uses` (Number) How many agents can enroll with this token, from 1 to 50. Defaults to `1`.

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Enrollment token ID.
- `install_commands` (Map of String, Sensitive) Ready-to-run install commands with the token and control-plane host already substituted, keyed by `linux`, `windows`, `macos` and, for a `kubernetes` token, `helm`. Sensitive because each one embeds the token.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The plaintext enrollment token. Returned only at creation, so it is stored in state and anyone with state access can read it.
